why: The overlay is the instrument #372's 'attentive, not omniscient' judgement is made through, so a wrong state here produces a wrong ruling rather than a cosmetic defect. Dropping the expiry makes a tank that has given up and started searching still read as 'remembering', which collapses two of the three states the issue asks the trace to distinguish. MEASURED: tools/gl/harness.ts does NOT catch this -- its three-state frames still differ, because the label text carries the difference (m55 against m0) even when the classification is wrong. The jsdom test is the only coverage that does.
killedBy: contactStateOf tells the three states #372 names apart NONE: memory expired
